scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Do you need a Falcon?
With a magical Flute, you can call your Falcon from anywhere!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
您需要猎鹰吗？
只要拥有神奇的笛子，您就能在任意地点召唤您的猎鹰！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Hello, young one!
Currently I can't help you,
but why don't you return to me when you've become a great Hunter and learned how to handle Falcons properly?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
你好，年轻人！
目前我还帮不了你，
不过等你成为伟大的猎人，并学会如何驾驭猎鹰时，欢迎再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Isn't it a beautiful day today?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
今天天气真好啊！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
It's marvelous, isn't it? Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
真是美妙的一天，不是吗？哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Why I'm selling these Falcon Flutes?
It's because I have no clue how they work.
Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
至于我为什么要卖这些猎鹰笛？
那是因为我完全不知道它们是怎么运作的。
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Of course, you'll need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000.
I don't have the Skill, so I don't know how to handle Falcons.
As it's for now, I may never have a Falcon.
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
当然，你需要技能^ff0000猎鹰精通^000000。
我没有这个技能，所以不知道如何驾驭猎鹰。
就目前而言，我可能永远都不会拥有猎鹰了。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
But I can't give you one for free!
I have to make money since i also need to eat!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
但我不能免费送你一个！
我也得赚钱，毕竟我也得吃饭啊！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
If you need a Falcon Flute I will sell them for 12,500 zeny. Or is that too expensive?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
如果你需要猎鹰笛，我会以12,500 Zeny的价格出售。或者你觉得太贵了？

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
For Rangers, however, I have a special price of 10,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
不过，对于游侠来说，我有个特别价：10,000 Zeny！

scripts.text: Don't buy one
scripts.translation: 不买

scripts.text: Buy a Falcon Flute
scripts.translation: 购买猎鹰笛

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
That's too bad. If you need one, come back!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
真遗憾。如果你需要，欢迎随时回来！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
As I can see you already have a Falcon Flute!
Don't worry, my young friend, once you've purchased the Falcon Flute you won't need to do so again
since the Falcon Flute won't disappear upon usage, isn't that great?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
我看你已经有猎鹰笛了！
别担心，我年轻的朋友，一旦你购买了猎鹰笛，就不需要再买了，
因为猎鹰笛使用后不会消失，这不是很棒吗？

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Here, take this flute.
With it you can whistle for your Falcon from anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
给你，拿着这支笛子。
有了它，你可以在任何地方吹奏召唤你的猎鹰。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
Just a reminder.
You need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000 in order to use it!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
提醒一下。
你需要技能^ff0000猎鹰精通^000000才能使用它！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Flute Trader]
I'm sorry but you don't have enough money to buy a Falcon Flute, please come back when you have more money!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰笛商人]
抱歉，你的钱不够买猎鹰笛，请攒够钱后再来！

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
The Wolf Flute you have is crafted by myself, with wood.
You can come back here and find me if you lose your Wolf flute!
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
你拥有的狼笛是我用木头制作的。
如果你弄丢了狼笛，可以来这里找我！

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
The flute can only be crafted by me.
It is just a little matter for me to craft another flute!!
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
这支笛子只能由我来制作。
再制作一支笛子对我来说只是小事一桩！！

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
Do you need anything?
A new Wolf Flute?
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
你需要什么吗？
一支新的狼笛？

scripts.text: Please give me a new Wolf Flute.
scripts.translation: 请给我一支新的狼笛

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
Have you brought all the materials?
Wow! All your materials are not bad!
That's good enough.
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
材料都带齐了吗？
哇！你的材料质量都不错！
这就足够了。

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
Here's the new Wolf Flute.
Hope you are ready to use it.
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
这是新的狼笛。
希望你能准备好使用它。

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
If you want to craft a new Wolf Flute, I need you to bring me ^4d4dff1 Bamboo Cut and 100,000 zeny.^000000
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
如果你想制作一支新的狼笛，我需要你带给我^4d4dff1根竹片和100,000 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
^4d4dffBamboo Cut can be obtained from Kapha or Karakasa.^000000
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
^4d4dff竹片可以从钓鱼河童或伞妖身上获得。^000000

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
If you do not summon a wolf, then you don't need the Wolf Flute.
You can come back here and find me if you change your mind.
Isn't that right?
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
如果你不召唤狼，那你就不需要狼笛。
如果你改变主意了，可以来这里找我。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Expert Flute Crafter]
Eeehh? You are not a Ranger?
Then this flute is totally useless for you!
scripts.translation:
[长笛制作大师]
诶？你不是游侠？
那这支笛子对你来说完全没用！
